title: 第一卷 第336章 威风凛凛小恶魔桀桀桀第一卷 第335章 秘境是我的秘境里的你也是我的
slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：笨蛋美人当团宠，师兄们抢疯了！
第一卷第336章威风凛凛小恶魔桀桀桀（..la）百年时间可以发生很多事情，足够修真界洗牌，卧龙宗如今在修真界有着举足轻重的地位。
卧龙宗筑基期的慕潇婷这些年也没怎么努力，百年间到了金丹后期，只因她身为卧龙宗“元老”
级别的存在，平时没少在宗门作威作福。
别问，问就是她曾经和那位大小姐混的，学了大小姐的一些皮毛，传承大小姐的“优良”
品质。
此次龙族秘境事件宗主十分关注，作为卧龙宗的小姐妹团，经常在外面做一些“偷鸡摸狗”
的事儿，当然也没有那么邪乎，所谓的偷鸡摸狗，也就是小麻袋套男人，狠狠过一把馋瘾就放了。
有人问她为什么这么做？
她会回答：我怕那人回来我的手艺生疏了。
新来的弟子一头雾水，不明白这位师叔说的那个人到底是谁？
经历过卧龙宗差点被灭门的老一代弟子们却知道，她说的就是安慰失踪百年的小师姐。
别人只对新弟子说：“你不懂，没消停这是惦记着人家炼丹炉呢，一惦记就是一百年，但凡把惦记炼丹炉的心思放在修炼上现在都已经元婴了。”
“我呸，说了多少遍了，不要叫我没消停。”
“知道了知道了，天机阁那边已经查到了两处龙族入口，让我们各大宗门都派些人过去，这任务你接不接？”
“接接接，能不接吗？那可是龙族秘境，我想看看龙族秘境到底长什么样，里面有没有龙。”
“哎呀，宗主也不知道去哪里了，自从听到龙吟之后就消失了，现在还没回来，应该已经去龙族了，我们也赶紧过去支援。”
当天，消失的除了卧龙宗的宗主，还有聚宝阁阁主、以及名动天下的剑尊。
那三个人一去不回，幸亏如今的卧龙宗已经不是当初离不开大师兄的卧龙宗了，就算没有宗主，宗门内的长老们也可以把宗门安排得仅仅有条，随时等待宗主回来。
而今，各大宗门风波涌动，将统一目标瞄准了秘境入口。

舒晩昭也渐渐忙碌了起来。
她迎来了第一波“地鼠”
进入秘境的人一脸惊喜地感知龙族秘境所带来的灵力，感觉修炼的瓶颈都松动了不少，狠狠吸一大口灵气。
然而，刚一脚踏入秘境，还不等踏出第二步，就先闻到了一种香气和一阵桀桀桀的古怪动静。
定睛一看，疑似人类的女子，穿着黑红色的裙子，裙子的披风很大，看起来像是一对儿红色翅膀，手里捧着紫色的三叉戟，头顶叮叮当当挂了几串儿红色宝石，脑袋两侧按了一对儿奇形怪状的妙脆角。
发丝吹动，女子站在巨兽的顶端，将三叉戟瞄准他，漂亮的脸蛋刻意捏造出一副很邪恶的模样，唇瓣一勾，发出一串桀桀桀。
还不等他仔细研究她是人是龙，就见眼前发出一道强烈的光，巨大的叉子横空出世，将他叉了出去。
那人：“？？？”
做完这一切，舒晩昭踩了踩脚下的巨兽，“在这踩个脚印按个戳，等大龙来修复，我们去下一站，”
“吼——”
巨兽低吼一声，庞大的身躯慢慢一动，抬起“大象腿”
，对着秘境入口的位置按个“梅花印”
，做完一切之后按照舒晩昭指挥的方向慢吞吞挪动位置。
至于巨兽为什么这么听话？
因为头顶上的那条神经龙总是发神经，但龙身边跟了一只小小的“幼崽”
龙族秘境没有对外完全开放过，所以这里的生灵并不知道舒晩昭是什么生物，看她体型小小的，就默认是一只幼崽。
跟在龙族身边，它们不太聪明的脑袋第一想法就是龙祖宗这是把谁家的幼崽偷走了。
问题是龙祖宗对这只幼崽的态度很特别，和她相处愉快会上天翻云覆雨，和她相处不愉快，还是会上天翻云覆雨。

Recommended reading for all book friends: A stupid beauty becomes the group's favorite, and the senior brothers go crazy over her!
Volume 1 Chapter 336 The majestic little devil Jie Jie Jie (..la) A lot of things can happen in a hundred years, which is enough for the world of cultivation to reshuffle. The Wolong Sect now has a pivotal position in the world of cultivation.
Mu Xiaoting, who was in the foundation-building period of the Wolong Sect, had not worked very hard over the years. In the past century, she had reached the late stage of the Golden Core, just because she was the "eldest member" of the Wolong Sect.
The existence of this level usually dominates the sect.
Don't ask, the question is that she used to hang out with the eldest lady, learned some of the eldest lady's skills, and inherited the eldest lady's "excellence"
quality.
The sect leader is very concerned about this Dragon Clan Secret Realm incident. As a small sister group of Wolong Sect, they often do some "sneaking" outside.
Of course, it's not that evil. The so-called sneaking around, that is, using a small sack to trap a man, and then let him go after he is addicted to it.
Someone asked her why she did this?
She would answer: I'm afraid that my skills will be rusty when that person comes back.
The new disciple was confused and didn't understand who the person that the uncle was talking about was?
However, the older generation of disciples who had experienced the Wolong Sect being almost wiped out knew that she was talking about comforting the young senior sister who had been missing for a hundred years.
Others only said to the new disciple: "You don't understand. If you don't stop, you are thinking about someone else's alchemy furnace. You will be thinking about it for a hundred years. Anyone who puts his thoughts on the alchemy furnace and focuses on cultivation has already become a Nascent Soul."
"Bah, how many times have I told you, don't tell me to stop."
"I know, I know, Tianji Pavilion has found two entrances to the Dragon Clan, and asked our major sects to send some people there. Will you accept this task?"
"Continue, continue, can you not accept it? That is the Dragon Clan Secret Realm. I want to see what the Dragon Clan Secret Realm looks like and whether there are any dragons in it."
"Oh, I don't know where the sect master is. He disappeared after hearing the dragon's roar. He hasn't come back yet. He should have gone to the Dragon Clan. Let's hurry over to support him."
On that day, in addition to the sect leader of the Wolong Sect, the ones who disappeared were also the master of the Jubao Pavilion and the world-famous Sword Master.
Those three people never came back. Fortunately, the Wolong Sect today is no longer the Wolong Sect that could not live without the senior brother. Even if there is no sect leader, the elders in the sect can still arrange the sect in an orderly manner and wait for the sect leader to return at any time.
Now, the major sects are in turmoil, aiming at the entrance of the secret realm.
Shu Mingzhao also gradually became busy.
She ushered in the first wave of "gophers"
Those who entered the secret realm were pleasantly surprised when they sensed the spiritual power brought by the Dragon Clan Secret Realm. They felt that the bottleneck of their cultivation had been loosened a lot, and they took a deep breath of spiritual energy.
However, as soon as he stepped into the secret realm, before taking the second step, he smelled a fragrance and a strange and unruly movement.
Taking a closer look, a woman who looked like a human was wearing a black-red skirt with a large cloak that looked like a pair of red wings. She was holding a purple trident in her hand. There were a few strings of red gems hanging on the top of her head, and a pair of strangely shaped horns on both sides of her head.
Her hair was blowing, and the woman stood on the top of the giant beast, aiming the trident at him. Her beautiful face deliberately made a very evil look, her lips curled up, and she let out a string of jeering words.
Before he could carefully examine whether she was a human or a dragon, he saw a strong light coming out in front of his eyes, and a huge fork appeared out of the sky and thrust him out.
The man: "???"
After doing all this, Shu Mingzhao stepped on the giant beast under his feet, "Stomp on the footprints here and poke them, and wait for the dragon to repair them. Let's go to the next stop."
"Roar——"
The giant beast roared, its huge body moved slowly, and raised its "elephant legs"
, press "Plum Blossom Seal" on the location of the entrance to the secret realm.
, after everything was done, he slowly moved his position in the direction directed by Shu Mingzhao.
As for why the giant beast is so obedient?
Because the one above your headA nervous dragon is always nervous, but there is a little "cub" beside the dragon
The secret realm of the Dragon Clan has not been fully open to the outside world, so the creatures here do not know what kind of creature Shu Mizhao is. Judging from her small size, they assume that she is a cub.
Following the dragons, the first thought in their not-so-smart minds was whose cub the Dragon Ancestor had stolen.
The problem is that the ancestor of the dragon has a very special attitude towards this cub. If he gets along well with her, everything will turn upside down. If he doesn't get along with her, it will turn everything upside down.
